profile.headline: Engineering Lead | Technical Leader | Coach | Educator
profile.summary: With a diverse background spanning education, management, training, and software engineering, I possess a unique blend of skills and experiences that enable me to excel as a technical leader. Throughout my career, I've demonstrated a strong ability to coach, develop, and empower teams to achieve their goals, aligning closely with team values. I am passionate about fostering growth and success within my team, and I thrive in collaborative environments where empathy and leadership are paramount. My hands-on approach to technical leadership allows me to contribute effectively while driving architectural decisions and facilitating client interactions.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Development and delivery of scalable software solutions to streamline healthcare revenue cycle management processes.
• Manage Databricks pipelines leveraging Databricks, ensuring scalability, reliability, and performance for enterprise-level data workflows.
• Implementation of Unity Catalog to establish data governance, security, and streamlined collaboration across multiple teams.
• Designed and implemented robust APIs, microservices, and distributed systems using .NET C#, Node.js, Python, and Scala to power high-performance applications and integrations.
• Leveraged Anthropic and Open AI Foundry LLMs to optimize data extraction and ingest pipelines, supporting efficient processing of large datasets and ensuring compatibility with analytics frameworks.
• Designed and built modern, highly performant Angular UIs.
• Leveraged the Microsoft Azure stack, including APIM, AKS, Azure Functions, Service Bus, Blob
Storage, CosmosDB, and Azure SQL, to deliver cloud-native applications and support comprehensive data
solutions.
• Designed and managed Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform, automating the provisioning, configuration, and management of cloud resources.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define and implement best practices for data
architecture and management, aligning solutions with business objectives and innovation
strategies.
positions.insights: Skills: ASP.NET Core · Azure Databricks · Microsoft Azure · Microsoft SQL Server · Azure Data Factory · Scala · Angular · TypeScript · Entity Framework · Git · JavaScript · Microservices · Node.js · SASS · Web Services · Solution Architecture · Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) · SQL · Coding Standards · C# · gRPC · Azure Cosmos DB · Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS)

positions.title: Technical Lead
positions.description:
• Responsible for leading an agile team of engineers to design, build, and deploy re-architected, scalable, cloud-based system.
         • AWS - ECS, EC2, CloudFormation, S3, Lambda, RDS, DynamoDB, IAM
         • Typescript/Javascript, Angular, NodeJS, Express/NestJS 
• Architecting system level solutions in accordance with business and client needs. 
• Developing positive relationships with external clients along with internal product and engineering teams.
• Engaging with clients and internal stakeholders to gather project requirements and manage project scoping, estimation, and planning. 
• Identifying and removing bottlenecks that impede the progress of projects. 
• Solving issues and developing workarounds and alternative solutions. 
• Evaluating technology, risks, scope, and resourcing for solutions. 
• Work with the Product team to ensure close alignment to Product Roadmaps and successful delivery. 
• Planning for and guiding the creation of relevant solutions and implementation documentation.  
• Mentoring and developing team members. 
• Leading and encouraging a positive software development culture within the team.

positions.title: Engineering Manager/ Technical Consultant
positions.description:
• Led development team efforts towards successful product delivery.
• Establish and Maintain Development Standards and Practices. (Code review, source control, architecture, unit testing strategies). 
• Led migration of legacy applications to the cloud (AWS), database migration, and microservice architecture.
• Collaborate with architects, database admins, Salesforce Administrators, QA, business analysts and client stakeholders to plan, design, develop, and test enterprise applications.
• Provide technical leadership to teammates through coaching and mentorship.
• Assist in the translation of business need requirements into development of user stories.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Full stack engineer responsible for designing, building, implementing, and
maintaining software features within cloud-based web applications, supporting
services, and integrations. 

As a member of the Applications Development team, I was tasked with building out full scale web applications, APIs, and services using a variety of technologies including: C#, ASP.NET, .NET Core, Entity Framework, SQL, HTML, CSS (SASS, LESS), Javascript, Angular and Typescript. These are coupled with DevOps tasks such as continuous integration, build and release pipelines (YAML), and automation via Azure DevOps.  

Built custom Salesforce integrations such as ETLs, reporting services, API integrations, and applications. Engineered and maintained data synchronization services to/from Salesforce, built custom APEX modules, and many other microservice integrations to interface with custom Salesforce objects.

Practicing agile development practices with strong collaboration amongst engineers, Product/program managers, and QA team.  I am comfortable taking the lead, driving UI/UX design, architecture, development strategies, planning, and interfacing with key stakeholders.

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Design, develop, and implement custom web applications and services using ASP.NET MVC, Web Forms, C#, HTML, CSS, JavaScript.
• Built custom Salesforce integrations for internal applications and ETL processes.  Created services that bi-directionally synchronize data to/from Salesforce and designed custom applications that feed into the Salesforce interface allowing seamless integration.
• Design, develop, and implement integration solutions for Sitefinity CMS/WMS platform.
• Work as part of the development team to deliver potentially shippable increments of capability in short, regular intervals.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Full stack Developer utilizing a C# and ASP.Net MVC Framework on the backend with HTML, Javascript, CSS(LESS) on the front end. Built and maintained core functionality and new features on several client sites.

As a member of our 4 person development team, I collaborate with team members, UX Designers, and QA to build and optimize web tools for content marketing teams. Every member of the development team is asked to contribute to the full stack on all projects. As a Junior Developer, I am tasked with quickly learning and implementing tools to maximize efficiency.

positions.description:
• Completed 19-week intensive web development program, focusing on Ruby on Rails.
• Developed technical skills in Ruby, HTML5, CSS, JavaScript (JQuery and AJAX) and SQL.
• Built several sets of group projects, building skills in Agile Development, Test Driven Development, Git workflow, and pair programming.

positions.title: Teacher Programs Coordinator
positions.description:
•       Managed team of educators in the development and delivery of professional training programs for educators.
•	Analyze, design, implement, and evaluate a wide variety of science education teacher training programs.
•	Teacher program records including attendance, teacher stipends, and teacher credits received for programs.
•	Instructor for university partners providing graduate level credit.
•	Analyze and evaluate existing and new teacher training programs.
•	Strategic partnerships created to promote the Museum’s mission and reach new and diverse audiences. 
•	Create and maintain program marketing copy for website and print.

positions.title: Lead Educator
positions.description:
•	Multi-year training program co-developed for the design of needs-based curriculum and building capacity for teaching science.
•	3-year series of professional development seminars created and facilitated (to upgrade science content knowledge and improve pedagogy).
•	Science coach: Conducted recurring observations, met with grade level teams, and provided feedback.
•	Cultivated strategic partnerships with Chicago museums, philanthropic foundations, community-based organizations, and Chicago Public School administrators, principals, and teachers.
•	Education Developer of new physical science exhibit development team: 1) Co-wrote grant proposal sections focused on science learning through inquiry, 2) Presented concept development plan and science foundational documents to Executive Management team CCM Board of Directors, and external funders.
•	Institutional expert on science inquiry; spearheaded STEM initiatives within the museum.

positions.title: Teacher Programs Educator and Trainer
positions.description:
• Supervised and led team of teacher training interns, and fostered strategic relationships with administrators, teachers, and students in partnership grant with select CHICAGO PUBLIC SCHOOLS.
• Curriculum, training modules, and resources based on the Art Institute’s collection for specific needs of CHICAGO PUBLIC SCHOOL educators.
• Created visual learning resource for CPS high school students tying the Art Institute’s collection with all major disciplines in accordance with Illinois State Learning Standards.
positions.insights: Skills: Communication · Coaching & Mentoring · Team Leadership · Leadership

positions.description:

• Oversaw studio work, managed inventory, controlled budget, and coordinated exhibitions.

projects.title: Jam Session
projects.description: Jam Session is a social networking app that allows musicians to find other musicians in Chicago to jam with. Musicians can seek out other musicians in their neighborhood by instrument type and skill level and send an internal message to request a meet up.
